questions.question: When was aspirin first started, and what was the original indication?
When was the coronary stent placed, and was aspirin initiated or adjusted at that time?
Was the dental extraction carried out, and if so, was aspirin resumed afterward?
Are there documented bleeding risks, contraindications, or clinical rationale for holding aspirin before dental extraction?
What other antiplatelet or anticoagulant medications are recorded, and when were they started or changed?
Is there documentation of patient discussion or shared decision-making about stopping aspirin pre-procedure?
